Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply negative, leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is useless; it's trading at 83.56 and down 62.82%. Re-evaluate your risk on this 3X leveraged ETF immediately.
MUU & SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are also down significantly (-35.44% and -37.38%). Review their stops and consider trimming to reduce margin exposure.
